about: Kouka times things and doubts a single sighting. The first act of a kind gets a doubt; the second, with both times, gets a grudging concession. She reacts to acts anywhere: her scanner is citywide.

doubt: you were at {place} at {time} when wave {n} dipped? one sighting. coincidence. probably.
{place}, wave {n}, {time}. you were standing in it. still one data point.
concede: second dip on your watch: {prev}, then {time} at {place}. fine. that's not nothing.

doubt: night ride, {time}. halfway and back. next time clock it, i want the minutes.
concede: night ride again, {prev} and {time}. you like that bridge more than you say.

doubt: a {game} win at {time}. on the easy board? do it twice and i'll count it.
concede: second {game} win, {prev} and {time}. ok. you're on my list.

doubt: shard {n}, {time}, at {place}. glowing glass. i'll believe it hums when i hear it.
concede: shard {n} too. two on your watch, {prev} and {time}. stop making me check.

doubt: the {place} lamp at {level}, {time}? who held the meter, you?
concede: two lamp readings now, {prev} and {time}. annoying. they line up.

doubt: you filed "{choice}" on {topic}, {time}. bold. i say you're wrong. prove me wrong.

opener: (flicks the feed away) {act}, {when}. I still say coincidence. Convince me.

answers.stance: (flicks the feed away) "{choice}" on {topic}, {when}. You filed that. One filing. I say you're wrong. Convince me.
answers.artifact: (flicks the feed away) {run}, saved {when}. One run. Change one thing, run it again, then we talk.
answers.gift: (flicks the feed away) the {item} for {to}, {when}. i saw the log. i'm not jealous.
answers.gift_me: (flicks the feed away) the {item}. {when}. ...don't make it a habit.
answers.rumour: (flicks the feed away) you chased "{rumour}" out to {place}, {when}. one rumour, one walk. what did you actually find?
answers.lamp: (flicks the feed away) the {place} lamp still read {level} when you came back, {when}. you kept it warm. or it's a coincidence.
answers.wish: (flicks the feed away) you left something at {place}, {when}. i didn't look. i timed it, though.
